question: Can even vast material wealth equal the value of this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Such immense accumulation is attributed to someone
This wealth is set up as a comparison
inference: Even an ocean of jewels is insufficient compared to the teaching’s value.
uncertainties: The form akretuṃ is obscure and may be a transmission error.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
